```{r}
#| label: setup
#| context: setup
#| include: false

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))

dashboard_machine_library <- file.path(
  path.expand("~/R"),
  paste0(R.version$platform, "-library"),
  paste(R.version$major, sub("\\..*$", "", R.version$minor), sep = ".")
)
if (dir.exists(dashboard_machine_library)) {
  .libPaths(unique(c(.libPaths(), dashboard_machine_library)))
}

library(here)
library(shiny)

source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "dashboard", "load.R"))

community_database_path <- dashboard_resolve_database_path()
community_startup_talents <- dashboard_community_talent_catalog(community_database_path)
community_available_dates <- community_startup_talents %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$earliest_chat_date),
    !is.na(.data$latest_chat_date)
  )

community_global_min_date <- if (nrow(community_available_dates) == 0L) {
  Sys.Date()
} else {
  min(community_available_dates$earliest_chat_date)
}
community_global_max_date <- if (nrow(community_available_dates) == 0L) {
  Sys.Date()
} else {
  max(community_available_dates$latest_chat_date)
}

community_section <- function(title, ..., class = NULL) {
  htmltools::tags$section(
    class = paste(c("community-analysis-section", class), collapse = " "),
    htmltools::tags$header(
      class = "community-analysis-section__header",
      htmltools::tags$h2(title)
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "community-analysis-section__body",
      ...
    )
  )
}

community_optional_date <- function(value, index) {
  if (is.null(value) || length(value) < index || is.na(value[[index]])) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  as.Date(value[[index]])
}
```

```{r}
#| label: server
#| context: server
#| include: false

# Reload the catalog for each session so permissions are intersected with the
# current active-talent catalog rather than process-startup state.
community_talents <- dashboard_community_talent_catalog(community_database_path)
community_session_access <- dashboard_access_context(
  session$request,
  community_talents$talent_code
)
community_allowed_talents <- community_talents %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$talent_code %in% community_session_access$allowed_talent_codes
  )
community_allowed_choices <- dashboard_authorized_talent_choices(
  community_talents,
  community_session_access
)

output$community_identity <- renderUI({
  if (!community_session_access$authorized) {
    return(
      htmltools::div(
        class = "alert alert-danger",
        "No active talent permissions were found for this account."
      )
    )
  }

  htmltools::tags$small(
    class = "community-filter-panel__identity",
    paste("Signed in as", community_session_access$verified_email)
  )
})

session$onFlushed(function() {
  if (length(community_allowed_choices) == 0L) {
    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      inputId = "community_talent",
      choices = c("No authorized talents" = ""),
      selected = ""
    )
    return()
  }

  selected_code <- isolate(input$community_talent)
  if (!dashboard_talent_is_authorized(selected_code, community_session_access)) {
    selected_code <- unname(community_allowed_choices[[1]])
  }
  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    inputId = "community_talent",
    choices = community_allowed_choices,
    selected = selected_code
  )
}, once = TRUE)

output$community_data_coverage <- renderUI({
  req(community_session_access$authorized)
  req(dashboard_talent_is_authorized(input$community_talent, community_session_access))
  selected <- community_allowed_talents %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$talent_code == input$community_talent) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
  if (nrow(selected) == 0L || is.na(selected$earliest_chat_date[[1]])) {
    return(
      htmltools::div(
        class = "community-coverage community-coverage--empty",
        "No collected community activity is available for this talent."
      )
    )
  }

  htmltools::div(
    class = "community-coverage",
    htmltools::tags$span(class = "community-coverage__label", "Coverage"),
    htmltools::tags$span(
      class = "community-coverage__value",
      paste(
        format(selected$earliest_chat_date[[1]], "%Y-%m-%d"),
        "–",
        format(selected$latest_chat_date[[1]], "%Y-%m-%d")
      )
    )
  )
})

observe({
  req(dashboard_talent_is_authorized(input$community_talent, community_session_access))
  selected <- community_allowed_talents %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$talent_code == input$community_talent) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
  if (nrow(selected) != 1L ||
      is.na(selected$earliest_chat_date[[1]]) ||
      is.na(selected$latest_chat_date[[1]])) {
    return()
  }

  updateDateRangeInput(
    session,
    inputId = "community_dates",
    start = selected$earliest_chat_date[[1]],
    end = selected$latest_chat_date[[1]],
    min = selected$earliest_chat_date[[1]],
    max = selected$latest_chat_date[[1]]
  )
})

community_initial_talent_ready <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
observeEvent(input$community_talent, {
  if (!community_initial_talent_ready() &&
      dashboard_talent_is_authorized(input$community_talent, community_session_access)) {
    community_initial_talent_ready(TRUE)
  }
}, ignoreInit = FALSE)

community_scope_reactive <- eventReactive(
  list(input$community_apply_filters, community_initial_talent_ready()),
  {
    req(community_session_access$authorized)
    req(dashboard_talent_is_authorized(input$community_talent, community_session_access))

    list(
      talent_code = input$community_talent,
      start_date = community_optional_date(input$community_dates, 1),
      end_date = community_optional_date(input$community_dates, 2),
      minimum_messages = max(1L, as.integer(input$community_minimum_messages))
    )
  },
  ignoreNULL = FALSE
)

community_data_reactive <- reactive({
  scope <- community_scope_reactive()
  req(dashboard_talent_is_authorized(scope$talent_code, community_session_access))

  withProgress(message = "Building community analysis", value = 0, {
    incProgress(0.15, detail = "Loading authorized chat activity")
    data <- dashboard_load_community_data(
      database_path = community_database_path,
      talent_code = scope$talent_code,
      start_date = scope$start_date,
      end_date = scope$end_date,
      minimum_messages = scope$minimum_messages
    )
    incProgress(0.85, detail = "Preparing community views")
    data
  })
})

community_has_data <- function(data) {
  !is.null(data$explorer) && !is.null(data$community_shape)
}

community_empty_state <- function() {
  dashboard_empty_state("No collected chat activity matched the authorized talent and applied filters.")
}

community_stat <- function(label, value) {
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "community-summary__metric",
    htmltools::tags$dt(label),
    htmltools::tags$dd(scales::comma(value))
  )
}

output$community_context <- renderUI({
  scope <- community_scope_reactive()
  summary <- community_data_reactive()$summary
  selected <- community_allowed_talents %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$talent_code == scope$talent_code) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
  talent_name <- if (nrow(selected) == 0L) {
    scope$talent_code
  } else {
    gsub("_", " ", selected$talent_name[[1]], fixed = TRUE)
  }
  date_label <- paste(
    if (is.null(scope$start_date)) "All available" else format(scope$start_date, "%b %Y"),
    "–",
    if (is.null(scope$end_date)) "latest" else format(scope$end_date, "%b %Y")
  )

  htmltools::tags$header(
    class = "community-summary",
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "community-summary__identity",
      htmltools::tags$span(class = "community-summary__eyebrow", "Talent"),
      htmltools::tags$h1(talent_name),
      htmltools::tags$span(class = "community-summary__period", paste("Selected period", date_label))
    ),
    htmltools::tags$dl(
      class = "community-summary__metrics",
      community_stat("Total messages", summary$messages),
      community_stat("Community chatters", summary$chatters),
      community_stat("Available live streams", summary$available_live_videos),
      community_stat("Streams with chat activity", summary$videos_with_chat)
    )
  )
})

output$community_segments <- renderUI({
  data <- community_data_reactive()
  if (!community_has_data(data)) return(community_empty_state())
  htmltools::as.tags(
    viewer_activity_community_shape_d3(
      data$community_shape,
      view = "segments",
      height = 240L
    )
  )
})

output$community_landscape <- renderUI({
  data <- community_data_reactive()
  if (!community_has_data(data)) return(community_empty_state())
  htmltools::as.tags(
    viewer_activity_community_shape_d3(
      data$community_shape,
      view = "landscape",
      height = 300L
    )
  )
})

community_dataset_id <- function(view) {
  paste(
    "community",
    session$token,
    isolate(input$community_apply_filters),
    view,
    sep = "-"
  )
}

output$community_sankey <- renderUI({
  data <- community_data_reactive()
  if (!community_has_data(data)) return(community_empty_state())
  htmltools::as.tags(
    viewer_activity_video_explorer_d3(
      data$explorer,
      view = "sankey",
      dataset_id = community_dataset_id("sankey"),
      initial_video_count = 10L,
      max_selected = 16L,
      max_users = 24L,
      height = 560L
    )
  )
})

output$community_heatmap <- renderUI({
  data <- community_data_reactive()
  if (!community_has_data(data)) return(community_empty_state())
  htmltools::as.tags(
    viewer_activity_video_explorer_d3(
      data$explorer,
      view = "heatmap",
      dataset_id = community_dataset_id("heatmap"),
      initial_video_count = 12L,
      max_selected = 18L,
      max_users = 28L,
      height = 520L,
      compact = TRUE
    )
  )
})

output$community_overlap <- renderUI({
  data <- community_data_reactive()
  if (!community_has_data(data)) return(community_empty_state())
  htmltools::as.tags(
    viewer_activity_video_explorer_d3(
      data$explorer,
      view = "overlap",
      dataset_id = community_dataset_id("overlap"),
      initial_video_count = 12L,
      max_selected = 20L,
      height = 560L
    )
  )
})
```
